outcome: Prevalence of external anal sphincter defects
Prevalence of internal anal sphincter defects
cohort: 563 women who delivered their first child between 1990 and 1997
finding: Anal sphincter defects visualized on transperineal ultrasound 15-24 years after first delivery were associated with forceps delivery and development of fecal incontinence.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery was associated with an increased risk of both external and internal anal sphincter defects, while vacuum delivery was not significantly different from normal vaginal delivery.
